claim: apg demo creates a temporary workspace, blocks one sample, allows one sample, leaves the caller directory unchanged, and matches the published transcript
sandbox: fresh caller directory; bundled sample; assert two receipts exist only in the printed OS temp directory; normalize run-specific paths and fingerprints and compare every published transcript line

claim: A forbidden host is blocked before the client starts or connects
sandbox: fresh policy and local TCP listener; assert exit 10, no child marker, and zero accepted connections

claim: apg check evaluates and receipts an allowed request without opening a network connection
sandbox: fresh allowed policy targeting a local TCP listener; assert exit 0 and zero accepted connections

claim: A missing required environment value is blocked before the client starts
sandbox: fresh policy missing API_TOKEN; assert exit 10 and no child marker

claim: Receipts exclude environment values, headers, query strings, and request bodies
sandbox: fresh sample policy with value, query, and body canaries; assert the exact receipt schema and absence of every canary

claim: APG reads environment files as text and rejects shell expansion and command substitution
sandbox: fresh environment file containing command substitution; assert input error and no expansion marker

claim: Production requests require an allowed host, an allowed operation, and the exact production confirmation phrase
where: landing steps and policy section, README
sandbox: fresh production policy; assert missing and wrong phrases block, disallowed operations block, and the exact allowed request passes

claim: Checked URLs use HTTP or HTTPS and an exact allowed host; deny rules beat allow rules; required JSON paths are enforced; exits distinguish pass, block, and invalid input
sandbox: fresh production policy; exercise invalid scheme, deceptive host, overlapping deny, missing body, and allowed nested JSON with exact exit codes

claim: An allowed run substitutes the checked URL, passes environment values without printing them, keeps client output clean, writes the decision to standard error, and returns the client exit code
sandbox: fresh allowed sample; parse client stdout and APG stderr as separate JSON values

claim: A source checkout installs one apg 0.1.0 executable
sandbox: fresh Cargo install root; install the current checkout with the lockfile; assert one executable and its version

claim: The browser demo uses only demo-prefixed session storage and does not change real browser storage
sandbox: fresh browser with real storage canaries; enter, change, reset, and leave demo; assert canaries unchanged and demo keys removed

claim: The browser sample blocks a wrong production host and allows the approved host
sandbox: fresh browser demo; assert the seeded wrong host is blocked, then change only the URL and assert the approved request passes

claim: The browser sample does not send entered request data or start a client
sandbox: fresh demo after network idle; change and check the sample; assert zero subsequent browser requests

claim: The browser demo reloads offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser; load demo, wait for service-worker control, disable network, reload, and assert the sample result

claim: The sample works without an account
sandbox: fresh browser context; open demo directly; assert the result appears without auth responses or credential fields

claim: The website loads no analytics, advertisements, cookies, or third-party runtime scripts
sandbox: fresh browser context; record the full demo load; assert every request is same-origin and no cookies exist

claim: API Profile Guard is free software under the MIT License
sandbox: fresh clone; assert the repository license text and Cargo package metadata both specify MIT
